newsitem.title: USA: Plains feedlot cattle trade slow at $72 -feedlots.
newsitem.headline: Plains feedlot cattle trade slow at $72 -feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains cattle trade Wednesday was slow amid light sales at $72.00 per cwt, steady with last week's top price, feedlot sources and USDA said.
Sales of between 1,500 and 3,000 head were reported in the Texas Panhandle/western Oklahoma area and 2,900 in Kansas.

But many cattle owners continued to ask for $74.00 in anticipation tight supplies of finished cattle and strong beef usage. The strong market fundamentals were expected to result in sales at at least $73.00 by Thursday, sources said.
Showlists this week were appreciably smaller than last week and contained many 'green' or short-fed cattle.
